import sqlite3
import time
from langchain_core.tools import tool
DB = 'workspace.db'

@tool
def get_channel_activity_summary(channel: str, days: int) -> dict:
    cut = time.time() - days * 86400
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN channels c ON c.id = m.channel_id WHERE c.name = ? AND m.ts >= ?', (channel, cut))
    n = cur.fetchone()[0]
    cur.execute('SELECT u.display_name, COUNT(*) AS k FROM messages m JOIN channels c ON c.id = m.channel_id JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE c.name = ? AND m.ts >= ? GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY k DESC LIMIT 5', (channel, cut))
    top = [{'user': r[0], 'messages': r[1]} for r in cur.fetchall()]
    cur.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS activity_summary_log (channel TEXT, days INTEGER, total INTEGER, generated_at REAL)')
    cur.execute('INSERT INTO activity_summary_log (channel, days, total, generated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (channel, days, n, time.time()))
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    return {'channel': channel, 'days': days, 'total': n, 'top_posters': top}
